findings.issue: Hophal imperfect 3fs (be kindled / be burning) is rendered as active intransitive arderá, dropping the hophal stem force.
Each עליה suffix is 3fs (the fire). Spanish repeats masculine él, the same pronoun as 3ms בו (the altar), so the wood, the burnt offering, and the fats are placed on the altar instead of on the fire.
Definite plural H8002 (peace offerings) is replaced by the coined plural pazes, which only echoes paz and omits the offering noun.

notes: Waw-consecutive futures, the repeated morning, qal לא תכבה, and the construct fats match the tokens.
